basics.name: Sourav Basak Shuvo
basics.label: Biomedical Engineering Researcher
basics.summary: Biomedical Engineering graduate from KUET, Bangladesh. Researcher specializing in AI-based medical imaging, biomedical signal processing, and deep learning for cancer diagnostics. Three-time Dean's Award recipient. Actively seeking M.Sc./Ph.D. opportunities.

work.name: Bio-Neural Intelligence and Research Advancement (BINAR) Lab, KUET
work.summary: Conducting research in AI-based medical imaging and biomedical signal processing.
highlights: Deep learning frameworks for cancer classification and neurological disease detection
Multi-institutional research projects in bioinformatics and domain adaptation

work.name: Ulster University
work.summary: Investigated molecular interaction networks and gene pathways across multiple cancer types.
highlights: Applied bioinformatics tools to identify common therapeutic targets and drug candidates
Co-authored conference paper presented at EICT 2025

work.name: Fabrication Lab, KUET
work.summary: Operated fabrication equipment for biomedical device prototyping.
highlights: 3D printing, laser cutting, and CNC milling for student project support

volunteer.summary: Led the university's primary bioengineering student organization.
highlights: Organized workshops, seminars, and competitions on biomedical engineering topics

volunteer.organization: Spectrum – Professional Skill Development Club, KUET
volunteer.summary: Managed recruitment, team coordination, and HR operations.
highlights: Facilitated professional development programs for KUET students
Three Dean's Awards for academic excellence
Thesis: Gallbladder Cancer Classification using Parallel Transfer Learning, Multi-model Feature Fusion, and LSTM Networks (99.37% accuracy)

awards.title: Dean's Award (×3)
awards.summary: Awarded three times for outstanding academic performance in the Department of Biomedical Engineering.

awards.title: 2nd Runner-Up, Intra-University Project Competition
awards.summary: Awarded for the project: Automated Sanitary Napkin Vending Machine.

publications.name: TransfusionNet: Framework for Cervical Cancer Detection using Deep Learning with Multi-level Fusion
publications.summary: Proposes a deep learning framework leveraging multi-level feature fusion across multiple pre-trained architectures for cervical cancer detection.

publications.name: Classification of Gallbladder Cancer Using Average Ensemble Learning
publications.publisher: 2024 6th International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Information & Communication Technology (ICEEICT), IEEE
publications.summary: Ensemble learning framework combining parallel transfer learning, multi-model feature fusion, and LSTM for gallbladder cancer classification, achieving 99.37% accuracy.

publications.name: Exploring Common Molecular Interactions across Multiple Cancers to Identify Potential Therapeutic Targets and Drug Candidates
publications.publisher: 2025 7th International Conference on Electrical Information and Communication Technology (EICT), IEEE
publications.summary: Bioinformatics study of shared molecular interaction networks across multiple cancer types to identify common therapeutic targets and drug candidates.

publications.name: DL3M: A Vision-to-Language Framework for Expert-Level Medical Reasoning through Deep Learning and Large Language Models
publications.publisher: arXiv:2512.13742 (Under review in Medical Image Analysis, Elsevier)
publications.summary: Vision-to-language framework integrating deep learning with LLMs for expert-level medical reasoning from biomedical images.

projects.name: CholeNet: Gallbladder Cancer Classification (Undergraduate Thesis)
projects.summary: Hybrid framework combining quad-fold parallel transfer learning, multi-model feature fusion, and LSTM for gallbladder cancer classification. Achieved 99.37% accuracy.
highlights: Multi-model ensemble with LSTM-based sequential feature processing

projects.name: Brain Tumor Segmentation
projects.summary: MATLAB-based pipeline for automated brain tumor segmentation from MRI scans.
highlights: Classical image processing combined with deep learning segmentation

projects.name: MediConnect – Telemedicine Application
projects.summary: Video conferencing telemedicine application enabling remote patient-doctor consultations.
highlights: Full-stack development with real-time video consultation features

projects.name: VitaSync – Smart Vital Metrics Band
projects.summary: IoT-based wearable device for continuous monitoring of patient vital signs.
highlights: Tracks heart rate, SpO2, and other physiological metrics in real time
